parameters.command:
=sh -lc '
URLV="{{ $json.url || "" }}"
HOST="{{ $json.hostname || "" }}"
SCHEME="{{ $json.scheme || "" }}"
RETRIES="{{ $json.retries || 3 }}"
DELAY="{{ $json.retry_delay_seconds || 5 }}"
TIMEOUT="{{ $json.timeout_seconds || 20 }}"
CONNECT_TIMEOUT="{{ $json.connect_timeout_seconds || 10 }}"
FOLLOW="{{ $json.follow_redirects }}"
IGNORE_SSL="{{ $json.ignore_ssl_errors }}"
METHOD="{{ $json.http_method || "GET" }}"
POST_BODY_B64="{{ $json.post_body_b64 || "" }}"
BODY_MUST_NOT="{{ $json.body_must_not_contain || "" }}"
BODY_MUST_ANY="{{ $json.body_must_contain_any || "" }}"
USER_AGENT="n8n-url-availability-monitor/1.0"

if [ -z "$URLV" ] || [ -z "$HOST" ] || [ -z "$SCHEME" ]; then
  printf "STATUS=INVALID_URL\nURL=%s\nHOST=%s\nSCHEME=%s\n" "$URLV" "$HOST" "$SCHEME"
  exit 0
fi

POST_BODY=""
if [ -n "$POST_BODY_B64" ]; then
  POST_BODY=$(printf "%s" "$POST_BODY_B64" | base64 -d 2>/dev/null || true)
fi

CHECK_BODY="false"
if [ -n "$BODY_MUST_NOT" ] || [ -n "$BODY_MUST_ANY" ] || [ "$METHOD" = "POST" ]; then
  CHECK_BODY="true"
fi

CURL_WRITE_OUT="HTTP_CODE=%{http_code}|TIME_TOTAL=%{time_total}|URL_EFFECTIVE=%{url_effective}|REMOTE_IP=%{remote_ip}|SSL_VERIFY_RESULT=%{ssl_verify_result}|ERROR=%{errormsg}"
CURL_ARGS="-sS --max-time $TIMEOUT --connect-timeout $CONNECT_TIMEOUT -A $USER_AGENT -w $CURL_WRITE_OUT"

if [ "$FOLLOW" = "true" ]; then
  CURL_ARGS="-L $CURL_ARGS"
fi

if [ "$IGNORE_SSL" = "true" ]; then
  CURL_ARGS="-k $CURL_ARGS"
fi

attempt_no=1

while [ "$attempt_no" -le "$RETRIES" ]; do
  TMPERR=$(mktemp)
  TMPBODY=""
  if [ "$CHECK_BODY" = "true" ]; then
    TMPBODY=$(mktemp)
    CURL_OUT="-o $TMPBODY"
  else
    CURL_OUT="-o /dev/null"
  fi

  if [ "$METHOD" = "POST" ] && [ -n "$POST_BODY" ]; then
    RESULT=$(curl $CURL_ARGS $CURL_OUT -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "$POST_BODY" "$URLV" 2>"$TMPERR")
  else
    RESULT=$(curl $CURL_ARGS $CURL_OUT "$URLV" 2>"$TMPERR")
  fi

  RC=$?
  STDERR_TXT=$(cat "$TMPERR" | tr "\n" " " | sed "s/|/ /g")
  rm -f "$TMPERR"

  BODY_CHECK="PASS"
  BODY_SNIPPET=""
  if [ "$CHECK_BODY" = "true" ] && [ -n "$TMPBODY" ] && [ -f "$TMPBODY" ]; then
    BODY_SNIPPET=$(head -c 300 "$TMPBODY" | tr "\n\r|" " ")
    if [ -n "$BODY_MUST_NOT" ]; then
      OLDIFS="$IFS"
      IFS="|"
      for pat in $BODY_MUST_NOT; do
        if [ -n "$pat" ] && grep -qF "$pat" "$TMPBODY" 2>/dev/null; then
          BODY_CHECK="FAIL"
        fi
      done
      IFS="$OLDIFS"
    fi
    if [ "$BODY_CHECK" = "PASS" ] && [ -n "$BODY_MUST_ANY" ]; then
      found=0
      OLDIFS="$IFS"
      IFS="|"
      for pat in $BODY_MUST_ANY; do
        if [ -n "$pat" ] && grep -qF "$pat" "$TMPBODY" 2>/dev/null; then
          found=1
          break
        fi
      done
      IFS="$OLDIFS"
      if [ "$found" -eq 0 ]; then
        BODY_CHECK="FAIL"
      fi
    fi
    rm -f "$TMPBODY"
  fi

  printf "ATTEMPT=%s|BASE_ATTEMPT=%s|TIMEOUT_EXTRA_USED=%s|RC=%s|%s|CURL_ERROR=%s|BODY_CHECK=%s|BODY_SNIPPET=%s\n" "$attempt_no" "$attempt_no" "0" "$RC" "$RESULT" "$STDERR_TXT" "$BODY_CHECK" "$BODY_SNIPPET"

  # Éxito de transporte: no reintentar
  if [ "$RC" = "0" ]; then
    break
  fi

  # Solo reintentar fallos transitorios: DNS(6), connect(7), timeout(28), SSL EOF(56)
  if [ "$attempt_no" -ge "$RETRIES" ]; then
    break
  fi

  case "$RC" in
    6|7|28|56)
      sleep "$DELAY"
      attempt_no=$((attempt_no + 1))
      ;;
    *)
      break
      ;;
  esac
done
'

  "timeout_extra_retries_on_curl_28": 0,
  "timeout_extra_retry_delay_seconds": 5,
  "disabled_urls": [
    "https://hr-flow.gmontecristo.com/",
    "https://web-medismart-stage.gmontecristo.com/",
    "https://elastic-metrics-logs.grupomontecristo.com/",
    "https://kibana-metrics-logs.grupomontecristo.com/",
    "https://knowledge-base-mcp.buklo.dev/health",
    "https://datahub.grupomontecristo.com/"
  ]
}

parameters.command:
=sh -lc '
URLV="{{ $json.url || "" }}"
HOST="{{ $json.hostname || "" }}"
SCHEME="{{ $json.scheme || "" }}"
RETRIES="{{ $json.retries || 3 }}"
DELAY="{{ $json.retry_delay_seconds || 5 }}"
TIMEOUT="{{ $json.timeout_seconds || 20 }}"
CONNECT_TIMEOUT="{{ $json.connect_timeout_seconds || 10 }}"
FOLLOW="{{ $json.follow_redirects }}"
IGNORE_SSL="{{ $json.ignore_ssl_errors }}"
METHOD="{{ $json.http_method || "GET" }}"
POST_BODY_B64="{{ $json.post_body_b64 || "" }}"
BODY_MUST_NOT="{{ $json.body_must_not_contain || "" }}"
BODY_MUST_ANY="{{ $json.body_must_contain_any || "" }}"
USER_AGENT="n8n-url-availability-monitor/1.0"

if [ -z "$URLV" ] || [ -z "$HOST" ] || [ -z "$SCHEME" ]; then
  printf "STATUS=INVALID_URL\nURL=%s\nHOST=%s\nSCHEME=%s\n" "$URLV" "$HOST" "$SCHEME"
  exit 0
fi

POST_BODY=""
if [ -n "$POST_BODY_B64" ]; then
  POST_BODY=$(printf "%s" "$POST_BODY_B64" | base64 -d 2>/dev/null || true)
fi

CHECK_BODY="false"
if [ -n "$BODY_MUST_NOT" ] || [ -n "$BODY_MUST_ANY" ] || [ "$METHOD" = "POST" ]; then
  CHECK_BODY="true"
fi

CURL_WRITE_OUT="HTTP_CODE=%{http_code}|TIME_TOTAL=%{time_total}|URL_EFFECTIVE=%{url_effective}|REMOTE_IP=%{remote_ip}|SSL_VERIFY_RESULT=%{ssl_verify_result}|ERROR=%{errormsg}"
CURL_ARGS="-sS --max-time $TIMEOUT --connect-timeout $CONNECT_TIMEOUT -A $USER_AGENT -w $CURL_WRITE_OUT"

if [ "$FOLLOW" = "true" ]; then
  CURL_ARGS="-L $CURL_ARGS"
fi

if [ "$IGNORE_SSL" = "true" ]; then
  CURL_ARGS="-k $CURL_ARGS"
fi

attempt_no=1

while [ "$attempt_no" -le "$RETRIES" ]; do
  TMPERR=$(mktemp)
  TMPBODY=""
  if [ "$CHECK_BODY" = "true" ]; then
    TMPBODY=$(mktemp)
    CURL_OUT="-o $TMPBODY"
  else
    CURL_OUT="-o /dev/null"
  fi

  if [ "$METHOD" = "POST" ] && [ -n "$POST_BODY" ]; then
    RESULT=$(curl $CURL_ARGS $CURL_OUT -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "$POST_BODY" "$URLV" 2>"$TMPERR")
  else
    RESULT=$(curl $CURL_ARGS $CURL_OUT "$URLV" 2>"$TMPERR")
  fi

  RC=$?
  STDERR_TXT=$(cat "$TMPERR" | tr "\n" " " | sed "s/|/ /g")
  rm -f "$TMPERR"

  BODY_CHECK="PASS"
  BODY_SNIPPET=""
  if [ "$CHECK_BODY" = "true" ] && [ -n "$TMPBODY" ] && [ -f "$TMPBODY" ]; then
    BODY_SNIPPET=$(head -c 300 "$TMPBODY" | tr "\n\r|" " ")
    if [ -n "$BODY_MUST_NOT" ]; then
      OLDIFS="$IFS"
      IFS="|"
      for pat in $BODY_MUST_NOT; do
        if [ -n "$pat" ] && grep -qF "$pat" "$TMPBODY" 2>/dev/null; then
          BODY_CHECK="FAIL"
        fi
      done
      IFS="$OLDIFS"
    fi
    if [ "$BODY_CHECK" = "PASS" ] && [ -n "$BODY_MUST_ANY" ]; then
      found=0
      OLDIFS="$IFS"
      IFS="|"
      for pat in $BODY_MUST_ANY; do
        if [ -n "$pat" ] && grep -qF "$pat" "$TMPBODY" 2>/dev/null; then
          found=1
          break
        fi
      done
      IFS="$OLDIFS"
      if [ "$found" -eq 0 ]; then
        BODY_CHECK="FAIL"
      fi
    fi
    rm -f "$TMPBODY"
  fi

  printf "ATTEMPT=%s|BASE_ATTEMPT=%s|TIMEOUT_EXTRA_USED=%s|RC=%s|%s|CURL_ERROR=%s|BODY_CHECK=%s|BODY_SNIPPET=%s\n" "$attempt_no" "$attempt_no" "0" "$RC" "$RESULT" "$STDERR_TXT" "$BODY_CHECK" "$BODY_SNIPPET"

  # Éxito de transporte: no reintentar
  if [ "$RC" = "0" ]; then
    break
  fi

  # Solo reintentar fallos transitorios: DNS(6), connect(7), timeout(28), SSL EOF(56)
  if [ "$attempt_no" -ge "$RETRIES" ]; then
    break
  fi

  case "$RC" in
    6|7|28|56)
      sleep "$DELAY"
      attempt_no=$((attempt_no + 1))
      ;;
    *)
      break
      ;;
  esac
done
'

activeVersion.name: Deshabilitar datahub del monitoreo de URLs
activeVersion.description: Se agrega https://datahub.grupomontecristo.com/ al array disabled_urls del nodo Set - Params (el Function – Expand URLs ya filtra las URLs de disabled_urls). La URL permanece en monitor_urls (no se borra); solo deja de chequearse. Reversible quitandola de disabled_urls. No se toca ningun otro parametro ni nodo.
